about_zh: 编辑器、终端、构建、测试——日常写代码的那一圈。

repos.description: A collective list of free APIs
repos.summary_zh: public-apis 是一个由社区维护的免费 API 集合库，涵盖地理定位、金融、天气、通信等多个领域，提供即用型 RESTful API 接口，支持 Postman 一键调用，助力开发者快速集成第三方数据服务。
repos.summary_en: The public-apis repository is a community-curated collection of free, ready-to-use REST APIs across diverse domains like geolocation, finance, weather, and communication, enabling developers to quickly integrate third-party data services via Postman.

repos.description: The definitive list that answers "I want to do X in Python, which tool should I use?"
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Python 是一个精选的 Python 框架、库、软件和资源的权威列表，涵盖 Web 开发、数据科学、机器学习、自动化工具等多个领域，为开发者提供高质量的开源工具参考。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Python is an opinionated curated list of top-tier Python frameworks, libraries, software, and resources across domains like web development, data science, machine learning, and automation, serving as a definitive reference for developers.

repos.description: The open source coding agent.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCode 是一个开源的 AI 编程智能体，支持终端和桌面应用。它通过命令行工具提供代码生成、编辑与自动化开发能力，兼容主流包管理器（npm、brew、scoop 等），并支持多语言界面。核心功能包括交互式编码、项目理解与重构，适用于开发者提升编程效率。
repos.summary_en: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that functions as both a terminal tool and desktop application. It enables code generation, editing, and automation via CLI, supports multiple package managers (npm, brew, scoop), and offers multilingual interfaces. Key features include interactive development, project comprehension, and intelligent refactoring to enhance developer productivity.

repos.description: 🙃   A delightful community-driven (with 2,500+ contributors) framework for managing your zsh configuration. Includes 300+ optional plugins (rails, git, macOS, hub, docker, homebrew, node, php, python, etc), 140+ themes to spice up your morning, and an auto-update tool that makes it easy to keep up with the latest updates from the community.
repos.summary_zh: Oh My Zsh 是一个社区驱动的 zsh 配置管理框架，提供 300+ 插件（如 Git、Docker、Node.js）和 140+ 主题，支持自动更新。它通过丰富的扩展功能提升终端体验，让用户在开发效率与个性化之间获得平衡，同时保持轻量与易用性。
repos.summary_en: Oh My Zsh is a community-driven framework for managing zsh configurations, offering 300+ optional plugins (e.g., Git, Docker, Node.js) and 140+ themes, with auto-update support. It enhances terminal productivity and personalization through extensible plugins and beautiful themes, balancing power and simplicity for developers.

repos.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: HelloGitHub 是一个专注于分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级开源项目的月刊，每月28日定期发布，涵盖有趣项目、开源书籍、实战及企业级项目。旨在通过精选优质开源内容，帮助用户快速发现开源魅力，激发学习兴趣，降低入门门槛，从而爱上开源生态。
repos.summary_en: HelloGitHub is a monthly publication that curates and shares interesting, beginner-friendly open-source projects from GitHub. Released on the 28th of each month, it features engaging projects, open-source books, practical tutorials, and enterprise-level codebases to help newcomers discover the joy of open source and build real-world skills quickly.

repos.description: Agents that use the browser.
repos.summary_zh: Browser-Use 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的网页自动化框架，通过 LLM 驱动浏览器完成复杂在线任务。支持主流大模型（Gemini、Claude 等），提供 stealth 模式云浏览器服务，实现高效、隐蔽的网页交互与数据采集，适用于自动化测试、信息抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: Browser-Use is an AI agent framework that enables LLM-driven automation of web tasks. It supports major LLMs (Gemini, Claude, etc.) and offers stealth cloud browsers for secure, scalable automation. Ideal for web scraping, testing, and data collection with seamless integration.

repos.description: :cn: GitHub中文排行榜，各语言分设「软件 | 资料」榜单，精准定位中文好项目。各取所需，高效学习。
repos.summary_zh: GitHub中文排行榜是一个按编程语言分类的中文开源项目榜单，涵盖软件与资料两类，提供总榜、增速榜和新秀榜，帮助开发者高效发现优质中文开源项目，降低语言障碍，提升学习效率。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Chinese Top Charts is a categorized ranking system of high-quality Chinese open-source projects by programming language, featuring software and knowledge categories, with overall, growth, and new repo rankings to help developers discover and learn from top Chinese projects efficiently.

repos.description: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
repos.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 是一款开源 AI 智能体，将 Gemini 的强大功能直接集成到终端中，提供对 Gemini 3 模型的轻量级访问，支持 Google 搜索、文件操作、Shell 命令等内置工具，并具备 MCP 扩展能力，专为命令行开发者设计，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
repos.summary_en: Gemini CLI is an open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal, offering lightweight access to Gemini 3 models with built-in tools like Google Search, file operations, and shell commands, plus extensibility via MCP (Model Context Protocol), designed for developers who live in the command line.

repos.description: Playwright is a framework for Web Testing and Automation. It allows testing Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with a single API.
repos.summary_zh: Playwright 是一个现代化的 Web 测试与自动化框架，支持 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 三大浏览器内核的统一 API 调用。其核心优势在于内置智能等待机制、原生支持跨浏览器测试、无人工超时设计，以及自动生成测试追踪与录屏功能，显著提升端到端测试的稳定性与效率。
repos.summary_en: Playwright is a modern framework for web testing and automation that provides a single API to test Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit browsers. It features built-in auto-waiting, cross-browser support, no artificial timeouts, and native tracing/video capture, making end-to-end tests more reliable and efficient.

repos.description: Model Context Protocol Servers
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的官方参考服务器实现，涵盖文件操作、网络抓取、Git 管理、内存存储等场景，支持多语言 SDK（Python、TypeScript 等），旨在帮助开发者理解 MCP 架构并构建安全的 LLM 工具集成方案。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers reference implementations of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, including file system access, web fetching, Git operations, and memory management. Built with multi-language SDKs (Python, TypeScript, etc.), it serves as an educational resource for developers to build secure LLM-integrated tools using MCP.

repos.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
repos.summary_zh: Orca 是一款下一代 AI 智能体开发 IDE，支持在 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上并行运行 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等多种 CLI 编码智能体。每个智能体独立工作树，统一管理与追踪，专为提升开发者 100 倍效率而设计。
repos.summary_en: Orca is a next-gen IDE for building with coding agents, enabling side-by-side execution of multiple CLI agents like Claude Code and OpenCode on macOS, Windows, and Linux. Each agent operates in its own worktree, centrally tracked and managed for maximum developer productivity.

repos.description: ALL IN ONE Hacking Tool For Hackers
repos.summary_zh: HackingTool 是一个集成化网络安全工具集，专为渗透测试与安全研究人员设计。支持185+工具、20个分类，涵盖匿名隐藏、漏洞利用、Web安全、移动安全等场景。具备智能搜索、标签过滤、一键安装与更新功能，兼容Linux/Kali/Parrot/macOS，提供现代化CLI交互体验。
repos.summary_en: HackingTool is an all-in-one cybersecurity toolkit for security researchers and pentesters. It integrates 185+ tools across 20 categories including anonymity, exploitation, web, and mobile security. Features include smart search, tag filtering, one-click installation/updates, OS-aware menus, and Docker support, optimized for Linux/Kali/Parrot/macOS with a modern CLI interface.

repos.description: :zap: Dynamically generated stats for your github readmes
repos.summary_zh: GitHub Readme Stats 是一个动态生成 GitHub 统计信息的项目，可自动在个人 README 中展示仓库贡献、语言使用、活跃度等数据，支持高度自定义主题、布局与指标，提升开发者主页展示效果。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Readme Stats dynamically generates GitHub statistics for READMEs, displaying repository contributions, language usage, activity metrics, and more. It supports customizable themes, layouts, and options to enhance developer profile visibility.

repos.description: The Python programming language
repos.summary_zh: CPython 3.15.0 alpha 6 是 Python 官方参考实现的源代码仓库，提供完整的构建指南、跨平台编译支持及开发者工具链。项目包含完整的标准库、构建系统（configure/make）、测试套件和性能优化选项（如 PGO 和 LTO），适用于开发、调试及生产环境部署。
repos.summary_en: CPython 3.15.0 alpha 6 is the official reference implementation of the Python programming language, containing source code, build instructions, and developer tools. It supports cross-platform compilation, includes the full standard library, test suite, and performance optimizations like PGO and LTO for production-ready builds.

repos.description: OmO: Just type "mass ulw" keyword with your prompt. Now you are the master of graph engineering.
repos.summary_zh: Oh My OpenAgent 是一个开源智能体开发框架，支持多模型协同工作流编排。它通过集成 Claude、GPT、Kimi、GLM、Gemini 和 Minimax 等主流大模型，实现代码生成、任务自动化与智能决策的开放生态。项目强调去中心化架构，反对厂商锁定，提供实时构建直播与 Discord 社区协作机制。
repos.summary_en: Oh My OpenAgent is an open-source agent framework enabling multi-model orchestration for code generation and automation. It integrates leading LLMs like Claude, GPT, Kimi, GLM, Gemini, and Minimax to build a decentralized ecosystem that rejects vendor lock-in. Features include real-time public development via Discord and support for diverse AI providers.

repos.description: ☄🌌️  The minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable prompt for any shell!
repos.summary_zh: Starship 是一款极简、极速且高度可定制的跨平台命令行提示符工具，支持任意 Shell（如 Bash、Zsh、Fish、PowerShell 等）。它通过 Rust 编写，性能卓越，能智能显示 Git 状态、编程语言版本、环境变量等上下文信息，极大提升终端使用效率与视觉体验。
repos.summary_en: Starship is a minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable cross-shell prompt written in Rust. It intelligently displays contextual information like Git status, language versions, and environment variables across any shell (Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell, etc.), enhancing terminal productivity and aesthetics.

repos.description: A list of cool features of Git and GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是 GitHub 和 Git 的高级功能速查表，涵盖隐藏特性如忽略空白符、分支对比、行号高亮、任务列表、Emoji 支持、Gist 使用、Hub 工具等，帮助开发者提升工作效率，适用于日常开发协作与代码审查场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a comprehensive cheat sheet of advanced Git and GitHub features, including whitespace ignoring, branch comparisons, line highlighting, task lists, emoji support, Gists, Hub CLI, and more—designed to boost developer productivity in collaborative coding and code review workflows.

repos.description: Chrome DevTools for coding agents
repos.summary_zh: Chrome DevTools MCP 是一个专为 AI 编码代理（如 Gemini、Claude、Cursor 等）设计的 MCP 服务器，通过 Chrome DevTools 协议实现浏览器自动化、性能分析与深度调试。支持网络请求分析、截图、控制台日志追踪及性能追踪，结合 Puppeteer 实现可靠操作，适用于网页自动化与智能调试场景。
repos.summary_en: Chrome DevTools MCP is an MCP server enabling AI coding agents (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Cursor) to control and inspect a live Chrome browser via the Chrome DevTools Protocol. It provides advanced debugging, performance tracing, network analysis, and screenshot capabilities using Puppeteer for reliable automation, ideal for web automation and intelligent debugging.

repos.description: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.
repos.summary_zh: Cypress 是一款专为浏览器端应用设计的现代化端到端测试框架，提供快速、易用且可靠的测试体验。它支持实时重载、时间旅行调试和自动等待等特性，显著提升前端测试效率与稳定性，适用于现代 Web 应用的全流程自动化测试。
repos.summary_en: Cypress is a modern end-to-end testing framework designed for browser-based applications, offering fast, easy, and reliable testing. It features real-time reloads, time-travel debugging, and automatic waiting to enhance frontend test efficiency and stability, ideal for full-stack automation across modern web apps.

repos.description: Fast, accurate & comprehensive text measurement & layout
repos.summary_zh: Pretext 是一个纯 JavaScript/TypeScript 多行文本测量与布局库，无需 DOM 即可精确计算文本高度和换行。它利用 Canvas 预渲染字体信息，避免昂贵的浏览器重排操作，支持全语言（含 emoji、混合双向文本），适用于虚拟滚动、动态排版、开发时文本溢出检测等场景，显著提升性能与跨浏览器一致性。
repos.summary_en: Pretext is a pure JavaScript/TypeScript library for accurate multiline text measurement and layout without touching the DOM. It uses Canvas-based font pre-measurement to avoid expensive browser reflows, supports all languages including emojis and mixed-bidi, and enables high-performance virtualization, dynamic layouts, and development-time overflow checks.

repos.description: A pure Unix shell script ACME client for SSL / TLS certificate automation
repos.summary_zh: acme.sh 是一个纯 Unix shell 脚本实现的 ACME 客户端，用于自动化 SSL/TLS 证书申请与续期。支持 ECDSA、通配符和多域名证书，兼容主流操作系统和容器环境，部署简单，仅需3分钟掌握，是运维自动化的理想工具。
repos.summary_en: acme.sh is a pure Unix shell script ACME client for automating SSL/TLS certificate issuance and renewal. It supports ECDSA, wildcard, and SAN certificates, runs on major OS platforms and containers, and is easy to deploy—masterable in just 3 minutes for efficient DevOps automation.

repos.description: Opensource IDE For Exploring and Testing API's (lightweight alternative to Postman/Insomnia)
repos.summary_zh: Bruno 是一款开源的 API 探索与测试 IDE，作为 Postman 和 Insomnia 的轻量级替代方案。它采用本地文件系统存储 API 集合，使用 Bru 标记语言描述请求，支持 Git 协作，并坚持离线优先设计，保障用户数据隐私。
repos.summary_en: Bruno is an open-source IDE for exploring and testing APIs, designed as a lightweight alternative to Postman and Insomnia. It stores collections locally using the Bru markup language, supports Git-based collaboration, and operates entirely offline to ensure data privacy.

repos.description: Beautiful, Modern & Opinionated Linux
repos.summary_zh: Omarchy 是 DHH 出品的现代 Opinionated Linux 发行版，以美观界面、内置 AI 智能体能力、Neovim 与终端工作流为核心亮点。提供完善的一键配置、主题系统、dotfiles 管理与跨平台适配，面向追求高效开发体验的工程师群体。
repos.summary_en: Omarchy is a beautiful, opinionated Linux distro by DHH featuring built-in AI agent capabilities, Neovim-centric workflows, and a polished terminal environment. It offers one-click configuration, theming, dotfiles management, and cross-platform support for developers seeking a productivity-optimized OS.

repos.description: the runtime your coding agents live on
repos.summary_zh: Herdr 是一个基于 Rust 构建的终端 AI 智能体运行时，支持多任务并行、会话持久化及跨设备重新连接。它提供原生终端视图与 Socket API，允许智能体间协作，并通过插件扩展工作流，专为开发者打造高效自动化环境。
repos.summary_en: Herdr is a Rust-based terminal runtime for AI agents, supporting multi-tasking, session persistence, and reattachment across devices. It offers native terminal views and a Socket API for agent collaboration, extensible via plugins, designed to build efficient automation environments for developers.

repos.description: The uncompromising Python code formatter
repos.summary_zh: Black 是一个无妥协的 Python 代码格式化工具，强制统一代码风格，提升团队协作效率。它基于 AST 分析实现确定性格式化，支持 Python 3.10+ 及 Jupyter Notebook，提供极小 diff 输出以加速代码审查，并内置语法有效性验证确保代码安全。
repos.summary_en: Black is the uncompromising Python code formatter that enforces consistent style across projects. It reformats entire files in place using AST analysis, supports Python 3.10+ and Jupyter Notebooks, produces minimal diffs for faster code reviews, and validates syntax safety through built-in AST checks.

repos.description: Open-source Rust agent engine and terminal client for Codewhale, with provider choice, tools, approvals and receipts.
repos.summary_zh: Codewhale是开源终端编程智能体，用Rust构建，支持任意AI模型。它能读取项目、编辑文件、运行命令并验证结果，适用于自动化代码修复、测试调试与本地开发工作流，提供TUI交互与headless模式。
repos.summary_en: Codewhale is an open-source coding agent for the terminal, built in Rust and compatible with any AI model. It reads projects, edits files, runs commands, and verifies its own work, suitable for automated code fixes, test debugging, and local development workflows, with TUI and headless modes.

repos.description: Open-source coding agent for your terminal, built in Rust and on a journey of continuous community improvement. Issues and PRs welcome.
repos.summary_zh: Codewhale是一款基于Rust构建的开源终端AI编码代理，支持连接多种大模型提供商（含Ollama/vLLM本地部署），具备文件编辑、命令执行、任务规划等完整能力。采用分层审批机制保障执行安全，支持MCP协议扩展与Agent协作，可持久化会话与目标管理，适用于开发者终端工作流自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Codewhale is an open-source Rust-based AI coding agent for the terminal, connecting to various LLM providers including local Ollama/vLLM deployments. It supports file editing, command execution, and task planning with tiered approval for safety. Features MCP extensibility, multi-agent coordination, and session persistence, ideal for developer terminal automation workflows.

repos.description: Open-source coding agent for your terminal, built in Rust and on a journey of continuous community improvement. Issues and PRs welcome.
repos.summary_zh: CodeWhale 是一款基于 DeepSeek V4 模型的终端编程智能体，支持流式推理输出、本地文件编辑（带审批机制）、Shell 命令执行、Git 操作及子代理协调。提供自动模式智能选择模型与思维层级，具备 1M 上下文窗口与缓存成本追踪，适用于高效终端开发辅助。
repos.summary_en: CodeWhale is a terminal-based coding agent powered by DeepSeek V4, featuring streaming reasoning blocks, local file editing with approval gates, shell/Git/web tools, and sub-agent coordination. It includes auto mode for dynamic model/thinking selection, 1M-token context support, and prefix-cache cost tracking for efficient development workflows.

repos.description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
repos.summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提升 AI 提示词质量的优化工具，支持多轮迭代优化、双模式提示词处理、实时对比测试及多模型集成（OpenAI/Gemini/DeepSeek等），同时提供文生图、图生图、MCP协议支持等高级功能，适用于角色扮演、知识图谱提取、创意写作等场景。
repos.summary_en: Prompt Optimizer is an AI prompt optimization tool designed to enhance prompt quality through intelligent refinement, multi-round iteration, and dual-mode optimization. It supports real-time comparison, integration with major AI models (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek), advanced features like text-to-image generation, MCP protocol compatibility, and secure client-side processing for reliable and efficient prompt engineering.

repos.description: Fish-like autosuggestions for zsh
repos.summary_zh: zsh-autosuggestions 为 zsh 终端提供类 Fish 的实时命令建议功能，基于历史记录和补全引擎智能生成建议。支持自定义高亮样式与建议策略，可无缝集成 Oh My Zsh，显著提升命令行输入效率与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: zsh-autosuggestions delivers Fish-like real-time command suggestions for zsh, leveraging history and completion engines. Features customizable highlighting and multiple suggestion strategies, integrates seamlessly with Oh My Zsh to boost terminal productivity.

repos.description: A reliable coding agent for complex software engineering tasks.
repos.summary_zh: Reasonix 是一款专为终端设计的 DeepSeek 原生 AI 编程智能体，基于前缀缓存稳定性优化，支持长时间运行且保持低 token 成本。其核心优势在于高达 99.82% 的缓存命中率，显著降低推理开销，适用于持续编码任务。
repos.summary_en: Reasonix is a DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for the terminal, engineered for prefix-cache stability to minimize token costs during long sessions. It achieves up to 99.82% cache hit rate, drastically reducing inference expenses while enabling persistent, efficient development workflows.

repos.description: dev tools, env vars, task runner
repos.summary_zh: mise 是一款基于 Rust 的多功能开发环境管理工具，集工具版本管理、环境变量配置和任务运行于一体。通过 mise.toml 文件统一管理 Node.js、Python、Terraform 等数百种开发工具的版本切换，支持目录级环境变量加载和自定义任务执行，确保本地、CI 和团队协作环境高度一致。
repos.summary_en: mise is a Rust-based comprehensive development environment manager that unifies tool version management, environment variable configuration, and task execution. It uses mise.toml to centrally manage versions of hundreds of dev tools like Node.js, Python, and Terraform, supports directory-scoped env vars and custom tasks, ensuring consistent setups across local, CI, and team environments.

repos.description: ⌥ Coding agent with the IDE wired in. Built by Stencil Labs.
repos.summary_zh: oh-my-pi 是一款功能强大的终端 AI 编程代理，内置 31 种工具和 60+ 大模型支持。采用 Rust 核心构建，支持 LSP/DAP 操作、哈希锚定编辑与子代理协同，为开发者提供类 IDE 的智能编码体验。
repos.summary_en: oh-my-pi is a powerful terminal-based AI coding agent featuring 31 built-in tools and 60+ LLM providers. Built on a Rust core (~80k lines), it supports LSP/DAP operations, hash-anchored edits, and subagent orchestration, delivering IDE-grade intelligent coding directly in the terminal.

repos.description: JumpServer is an Open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform with AI-powered capabilities, providing DevOps and IT teams a unified workspace to securely access SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, databases, websites, RemoteApp, VirtualApp, and more.
repos.summary_zh: JumpServer 是一款开源的堡垒机（PAM）平台，为 DevOps 和 IT 团队提供通过浏览器安全访问 SSH、RDP、Kubernetes、数据库及远程应用端点的能力，支持权限管理、会话审计与自动化运维，具备完善的 RBAC 权限控制与多协议支持。
repos.summary_en: JumpServer is an open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform enabling secure, on-demand access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, databases, and RemoteApp endpoints via a web browser, featuring comprehensive auditing, RBAC, and multi-protocol support for DevOps and IT teams.

repos.description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一个通用 CLI 中枢与 AI 原生运行时，可将任意网站、Electron 应用或本地工具转换为标准化命令行接口。支持浏览器自动化、70+ 内置站点适配器（如 Bilibili、知乎等）、AI 智能体无缝集成，具备反检测机制与零 LLM 成本运行特性。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is a universal CLI hub and AI-native runtime that transforms websites, Electron apps, and local tools into deterministic command-line interfaces. It features browser automation, 70+ built-in site adapters (e.g., Bilibili, Zhihu), anti-detection measures, and seamless AI agent integration with zero LLM token consumption.

repos.summary_zh: Void 是一款开源的 Cursor 替代 IDE，支持在代码库中使用 AI 智能体、可视化变更与检查点，并允许本地部署任意模型。其核心优势在于直接与 AI 服务商通信而不保留用户数据，基于 VSCode 深度定制，提供高度可定制的 AI 编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Void is an open-source alternative to Cursor, enabling AI agents to work on your codebase with checkpointing, change visualization, and local model hosting. It communicates directly with AI providers without storing your data, built as a VSCode fork with a focus on innovation over feature parity.

repos.description: YApi 是一个可本地部署的、打通前后端及QA的、可视化的接口管理平台
repos.summary_zh: YApi 是一款高效、易用、功能强大的可视化接口管理平台，支持本地部署，专为开发、产品、测试团队提供优雅的 API 管理服务。基于 Json5 和 Mockjs 定义接口结构，集成接口调试、自动化测试、Mock 期望等功能，支持 Postman/HAR/Swagger 导入，并提供丰富的插件生态与代码生成工具，助力企业级接口协作与效率提升。
repos.summary_en: YApi is a powerful, user-friendly, and efficient visual API management platform designed for developers, product managers, and QA teams. It enables seamless creation, publishing, and maintenance of APIs with features like Json5/Mockjs-based data modeling, automated testing, mock server with expectations, and support for importing from Postman, HAR, and Swagger. With a rich plugin ecosystem and code generation tools, it enhances API collaboration and productivity in enterprise environments.

repos.description: Patched fonts for Powerline users.
repos.summary_zh: Powerline 字体仓库提供专为 Powerline 状态栏插件优化的预配置字体，支持多种流行编程字体（如 Hack、Fira Mono、Meslo 等），涵盖 BSD、Apache、SIL 等开源许可证，适用于 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 终端环境，提升终端显示美观性与可读性。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides pre-patched fonts optimized for the Powerline statusline plugin, featuring popular programming fonts like Hack, Fira Mono, and Meslo under open licenses such as BSD, Apache, and SIL. It supports quick installation via script or package manager across Linux, macOS, and Windows terminals, enhancing visual appeal and readability.

repos.description: An open-source, AI-integrated, cross-platform terminal for seamless workflows
repos.summary_zh: Wave Terminal 是一款开源、集成 AI 的智能跨平台终端，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它兼容任意 AI 模型（如 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini），支持本地运行 Ollama 等模型，无需账户即可使用。核心特性包括：持久化 SSH 会话、内嵌远程文件编辑器、富文本预览（Markdown/图片/PDF）、AI 助手实时分析终端输出并操作文件，以及强大的 `wsh` CLI 工具实现工作区管理与跨会话数据同步。
repos.summary_en: Wave Terminal is an open-source, AI-integrated terminal for macOS, Linux, and Windows. It supports any AI model via BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or local models like Ollama/LM Studio. Key features include durable SSH sessions with auto-reconnect, built-in remote file editor, rich file previews (markdown, images, PDFs), context-aware Wave AI assistant that analyzes terminal output and performs file operations, and a powerful `wsh` CLI system for workspace management and cross-session data sync.

repos.description: agent multiplexer that lives in your terminal.
repos.summary_zh: herdr 是一款运行在终端中的智能体多路复用器，支持工作区、标签页和窗格管理，提供鼠标交互、拖拽分割、实时状态查看（阻塞/工作中/完成）等功能。无需 GUI 应用，直接显示智能体原生终端输出，支持断开后重连且智能体持续运行。适用于 Linux 和 macOS 系统，可通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装。
repos.summary_en: herdr is a terminal-based agent multiplexer that supports workspaces, tabs, and panes with mouse-native interactions like click, drag, and split. It displays real-time agent states (blocked, working, done) and shows the agent's native terminal output. Agents keep running after detach and can be reattached later. No GUI or Electron wrapper—works on Linux and macOS, installable via Homebrew or script.

repos.description: 🚀✨ Minimalistic, powerful and extremely customizable Zsh prompt
repos.summary_zh: Spaceship Prompt 是一款极简、强大且高度可定制的 Zsh 终端提示符，提供丰富的信息展示，包括 Git 状态、多语言运行时环境、包版本、电池电量、Kubernetes 上下文等，支持深度自定义配置，显著提升终端使用体验。
repos.summary_en: Spaceship Prompt is a minimalistic, powerful, and highly customizable Zsh prompt that displays essential information like Git status, runtime environments (Node.js, Python, etc.), package versions, battery level, and Kubernetes context, with extensive customization options for enhanced terminal productivity.

repos.description: 文言文編程語言 A programming language for the ancient Chinese.
repos.summary_zh: 文言（wenyan-lang）是一款基于文言文语法的编程语言，将古典中文与现代编程结合，支持自然语言编程风格。它可将文言文代码编译为 JavaScript，实现如 Hello World、埃拉托斯特尼筛法、快速排序等算法，兼具文化传承与实用功能，适合教学、趣味编程及跨时代语言实验。
repos.summary_en: Wenyan-lang is a programming language based on Classical Chinese grammar, blending ancient Chinese literature with modern programming. It compiles to JavaScript and supports natural language programming, enabling implementations of algorithms like Hello World, Sieve of Eratosthenes, and Quicksort, making it ideal for educational, cultural, and experimental use cases.

repos.description: Share your terminal as a web application
repos.summary_zh: GoTTY 是一个将命令行工具转换为 Web 应用的轻量级工具，支持通过浏览器远程访问终端会话。它提供端口监听、TLS 加密、基础认证、随机 URL 生成等安全特性，适用于运维、开发调试和远程协作场景。
repos.summary_en: GoTTY is a lightweight CLI tool that transforms command-line tools into web-based applications, enabling remote terminal access via browsers. It supports secure features like TLS encryption, basic authentication, random URL generation, and dynamic resizing for use in operations, debugging, and remote collaboration.

repos.description: ai副业赚钱大集合，教你如何利用ai做一些副业项目，赚取更多额外收益。The Ultimate Guide to Making Money with AI Side Hustles: Learn how to leverage AI for some cool side gigs and rake in some extra cash. Check out the English version for more insights.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为AI副业赚钱指南，系统整理利用AI技术开展副业的多种方法，涵盖内容创作、图片生成、音频处理、直播等方向。通过技术变现思路分享与实操案例，帮助用户在AI时代构建可持续的流量与收益模式，强调做垂类内容、卖工具（铲子）而非直接挖金子的策略。
repos.summary_en: This repository serves as a comprehensive guide to making money with AI side hustles, curating proven methods across content creation, image generation, audio processing, and live streaming. It emphasizes strategic positioning—focusing on niche content and selling tools (shovels) rather than competing in saturated markets—to help users build scalable AI-driven income streams in the current era.

repos.description: MCP for xiaohongshu.com
repos.summary_zh: 小红书 MCP 是一个专为 xiaohongshu.com 设计的自动化工具，支持登录验证、图文/视频内容发布、内容搜索、推荐列表获取、帖子详情抓取、评论互动及用户主页信息提取。采用本地路径优先的图片处理机制，确保上传稳定性，并提供完整的 HTTP API 与 MCP 工具调用支持，适用于内容运营与数据采集场景。
repos.summary_en: Xiaohongshu MCP is an automation tool designed for xiaohongshu.com, supporting login verification, publishing text/image and video content, searching posts, fetching recommended feeds, retrieving post details with interactions, commenting, and user profile data extraction. It prioritizes local file paths for media uploads to ensure stability, and offers full HTTP API and MCP tool integration for content operations and data collection.

repos.description: Python version of the Playwright testing and automation library.
repos.summary_zh: Playwright-Python 是微软开源的跨平台浏览器自动化库，支持 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 三大内核。提供同步/异步 API，具备无头模式、自动等待、网络拦截等特性，适用于端到端测试、网页爬虫和自动化任务，性能可靠且支持多平台部署。
repos.summary_en: Playwright-Python is Microsoft's cross-browser automation library supporting Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. It offers sync/async APIs with features like headless mode, auto-waiting, and network interception, ideal for E2E testing, web scraping, and automation across platforms with high reliability and performance.

repos.description: Superset is an agentic IDE to orchestrate 100+ coding agents in parallel. Run any agent with your own subscription.
repos.summary_zh: Superset 是专为 AI 智能体时代设计的代码编辑器，支持在本地并行运行多个 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 编码代理。通过 Git 工作树隔离任务、内置终端与差异查看器，实现零切换成本的高效开发流程，显著提升编码效率。
repos.summary_en: Superset is an IDE designed for the AI Agents Era, enabling parallel execution of multiple CLI-based coding agents like Claude Code and Codex on your machine. It isolates tasks via Git worktrees, provides built-in terminal and diff viewer, and eliminates context-switching overhead to boost development efficiency.

repos.description: A search tool helps dev to solve the naming things problem.
repos.summary_zh: CODELF 是一个智能变量命名工具，通过搜索 GitHub 等代码托管平台上的真实项目，为开发者提供精准的变量命名建议。支持 VS Code、Atom、Sublime Text 等编辑器插件，并集成每日算法题推荐功能，同时可管理 GitHub 仓库标签与收藏，显著提升代码命名效率与规范性。
repos.summary_en: CODELF is a smart variable naming tool that helps developers find real-world naming patterns by searching across GitHub and other code repositories. It offers IDE plugins for VS Code, Atom, and Sublime Text, features a daily algorithm practice guide, and includes GitHub repository tagging/organization tools to improve code naming consistency and productivity.

repos.summary_zh: Context Hub 为编码智能体提供版本化、语言特定的 API 文档管理，支持搜索、获取和反馈功能。通过本地注释和全局反馈机制，智能体可不断积累经验并提升代码准确性，所有内容以 Markdown 格式开源维护，便于审查和贡献。
repos.summary_en: Context Hub provides versioned, language-specific API documentation for coding agents. It enables search, fetch, and feedback capabilities, with local annotations and global voting to improve agent performance over time. All content is open-sourced in Markdown format for transparency and community contribution.

repos.description: OpenTUI is a library to build terminal user interfaces (TUI)
repos.summary_zh: OpenTUI 是一个用 Zig 编写的高性能终端用户界面（TUI）核心库，提供 TypeScript 绑定和 C ABI 接口，支持多语言调用。其组件化架构与灵活布局能力适用于构建复杂终端应用，已用于 OpenCode 和 terminal.shop 生产环境。支持 React、SolidJS 等前端框架集成。
repos.summary_en: OpenTUI is a high-performance terminal UI (TUI) core library written in Zig, offering TypeScript bindings and a C ABI for cross-language compatibility. It features a component-based architecture with flexible layouts, enabling complex terminal applications. Used in production by OpenCode and terminal.shop, it supports integrations with React, SolidJS, and more.

repos.description: A faster, simpler way to drive browsers supporting the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
repos.summary_zh: chromedp 是一个高效的 Go 语言库，用于通过 Chrome DevTools 协议驱动浏览器，无需外部依赖。它支持无头模式运行、页面截图、自动化操作等场景，适用于网页爬虫、自动化测试和数据采集。核心优势包括高性能、简洁 API 和跨平台兼容性。
repos.summary_en: chromedp is a high-performance Go library for driving browsers via the Chrome DevTools Protocol without external dependencies. It supports headless browsing, page screenshots, and automation tasks like web scraping and testing. Key features include fast execution, simple API, and cross-platform compatibility.

repos.description: A simple, open source bilingual translation extension & Greasemonkey script (一个简约、开源的 双语对照翻译扩展 & 油猴脚本)
repos.summary_zh: KISS Translator 是一款简约开源的双语对照翻译工具，支持浏览器扩展与油猴脚本两种形式。它适配主流浏览器，集成 Google、OpenAI、DeepL 等10+翻译服务，覆盖网页翻译、划词翻译、输入框翻译、YouTube字幕翻译等场景，支持自定义规则、术语词典、跨端数据同步及AI上下文记忆，提供高度灵活的翻译体验。
repos.summary_en: KISS Translator is a minimalist, open-source bilingual translation tool available as both a browser extension and a Tampermonkey script. It supports 10+ translation services including Google, OpenAI, and DeepL, covering web page translation, text selection, input field translation, and YouTube subtitle translation. Features include custom rules, term dictionaries, cross-device sync via KISS-Worker, and AI context memory for enhanced translation quality.

repos.description: 超级速查表 - 编程语言、框架和开发工具的速查表，单个文件包含一切你需要知道的东西 :zap:
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是专为开发者设计的中文速查表集合，涵盖编程语言（如 Bash、Python、Go、JavaScript）、开发工具（如 Git、Gdb、Tmux）和文本编辑器（如 Vim、Emacs）的核心语法与命令，每个速查表均为单个文件，便于快速查阅，解决日常开发中频繁查阅文档的问题。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a curated collection of Chinese cheatsheets for developers, covering programming languages (Bash, Python, Go, JavaScript), development tools (Git, Gdb, Tmux), and text editors (Vim, Emacs). Each cheatsheet is a single-file reference for quick lookup, eliminating the need to search scattered documentation.

repos.description: Generic automation framework for acceptance testing and RPA
repos.summary_zh: Robot Framework 是一个开源的通用自动化框架，专用于验收测试、验收测试驱动开发（ATDD）和机器人流程自动化（RPA）。它采用简洁的纯文本语法，易于扩展，支持跨平台运行，并通过丰富的生态系统和 Python 集成提供强大的测试能力。
repos.summary_en: Robot Framework is an open-source generic automation framework for acceptance testing, acceptance test-driven development (ATDD), and robotic process automation (RPA). It features simple plain-text syntax, easy extensibility via Python-based libraries, and cross-platform support, backed by a rich ecosystem of tools and resources.

repos.summary_zh: beautiful-mermaid 是一个高性能 Mermaid 图表渲染库，支持 SVG 和 ASCII 双输出模式，具备 15 种内置主题、零 DOM 依赖、同步渲染等特性，专为 AI 编程场景优化，可在终端和 UI 中无缝使用。
repos.summary_en: beautiful-mermaid is a high-performance Mermaid diagram renderer supporting dual SVG/ASCII output, 15 built-in themes, zero DOM dependencies, and synchronous rendering. Optimized for AI-assisted programming with seamless terminal and UI integration.

repos.description: :zap: Transfer files over wifi from your computer to your mobile device by scanning a QR code without leaving the terminal.
repos.summary_zh: qrcp 是一款通过扫描二维码实现电脑与移动设备间 Wi-Fi 文件传输的工具，无需离开终端即可完成操作。它通过生成包含随机路径 URL 的二维码，扫描后自动在移动端浏览器打开下载链接，支持单文件、多文件或文件夹传输，并提供压缩选项，兼容主流操作系统。
repos.summary_en: qrcp is a tool that enables Wi-Fi file transfer between computers and mobile devices by scanning a QR code, all from the terminal. It generates a QR code containing a URL with a random path; scanning it opens the download link in the mobile browser, supporting single/multiple files, folders, and optional compression. Compatible with Linux, macOS, and Windows.

repos.description: Grumpy is a Python to Go source code transcompiler and runtime.
repos.summary_zh: Grumpy 是一个将 Python 源码编译为 Go 源码并生成原生代码的转编译器，旨在作为 CPython 2.7 的近乎即插即用的替代品。其核心优势在于无虚拟机（VM），直接生成高效 Go 代码，通过 Grumpy 运行时库提供类似 Python C API 的功能，适用于高性能 Python 应用部署。
repos.summary_en: Grumpy is a Python-to-Go transcompiler and runtime designed as a near drop-in replacement for CPython 2.7. It compiles Python source to Go code, which is then compiled to native machine code—eliminating the need for a VM. This enables high-performance execution via a Go-based runtime library, offering a viable alternative for deploying Python applications with native speed.

repos.description: auto sign cursor
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是一个自动化 Cursor Pro 在线签到的工具，支持无人值守运行，适用于提升账户活跃度。采用 Python 实现，具备跨平台兼容性，并集成文档说明与社区支持，适合开发者学习自动化脚本与网页交互技术。
repos.summary_en: This project automates Cursor Pro online check-ins using Python, enabling unattended operation to boost account activity. It features cross-platform compatibility, comprehensive documentation, and community support, ideal for learning web automation and scripting techniques.

repos.description: Fuzzy String Matching in Python
repos.summary_zh: FuzzyWuzzy 是一个用于 Python 的模糊字符串匹配库，现已迁移至 TheFuzz。它提供高效的字符串相似度计算功能，适用于数据清洗、文本匹配等场景，支持多种匹配算法和加权评分。
repos.summary_en: FuzzyWuzzy is a Python library for fuzzy string matching, now migrated to TheFuzz. It enables efficient string similarity computation using various algorithms and weighted scoring, ideal for data cleaning and text matching tasks.

repos.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
repos.summary_zh: Worktrunk 是一个专为并行 AI 智能体工作流设计的 Git worktree 管理 CLI 工具，通过简化 worktree 操作使其像分支一样易用。支持自动化钩子、快速扩展多代理协作，显著提升开发效率与工作流自动化水平。
repos.summary_en: Worktrunk is a CLI tool for managing Git worktrees, optimized for parallel AI agent workflows. It simplifies worktree operations to be as easy as branches, with automation hooks and scalable multi-agent support for enhanced developer productivity.

repos.description: ✨ The agentic HTML editor — your local AI agent writes the HTML, you ship it. 🚀 75 Skills × 9 Surfaces (magazine · deck · poster · XHS / tweet · prototype · data report · Hyperframes) 🛡️ Sandboxed preview · 📤 1-click to WeChat / X / Zhihu / HTML / PNG 🔑 Zero API key — Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / Gemini / Copilot / OpenCode / Qwen / Aider.
repos.summary_zh: HTML Anything 是一款本地优先的智能 HTML 编辑器，集成 8 种主流编码代理 CLI（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等），无需 API 密钥。提供 75 个可组合技能模板，支持 9 种输出场景（杂志、海报、数据报告、小红书卡片等），一键导出至微信、X、知乎或生成 HTML/PNG 文件。
repos.summary_en: HTML Anything is a local-first, agentic HTML editor that integrates 8 coding agent CLIs (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) with zero API key required. It offers 75 composable skill templates across 9 deliverable formats—from magazines to data reports—and enables one-click export to WeChat, X, Zhihu, HTML, or PNG.

repos.description: A persistent service that generates mock data quickly and provids visualization view.
repos.summary_zh: Easy Mock 是一个快速生成模拟数据并提供可视化界面的持久化服务，支持团队协作、Swagger 导入、Mock.js 语法及自定义响应配置，适用于前后端分离开发中的接口模拟与测试。
repos.summary_en: Easy Mock is a persistent service that quickly generates mock data with a visualization interface, supporting team collaboration, Swagger import, Mock.js schema, and customizable responses for frontend-backend development and API testing.

repos.description: https://getsurfboard.com
repos.summary_zh: Surfboard 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的自动化工具平台，支持网页爬虫、数据抓取与任务自动化。它提供直观的界面和强大的调度能力，帮助用户快速构建和部署 AI 驱动的自动化工作流，适用于内容聚合、数据收集等场景。
repos.summary_en: Surfboard is an automation platform designed for AI agents, enabling web scraping, data extraction, and task automation. It offers an intuitive interface and robust scheduling to help users build and deploy AI-driven workflows efficiently, ideal for content aggregation and data collection.

repos.description: A configurable set of panels that display various debug information about the current request/response.
repos.summary_zh: Django Debug Toolbar 是一个可配置的调试面板集合，实时展示当前请求/响应的详细信息，包括 SQL 查询、模板渲染、缓存状态等，显著提升 Django 开发调试效率。支持社区贡献的第三方扩展面板，兼容 Django 4.2+，并提供异步视图实验性支持。
repos.summary_en: Django Debug Toolbar is a configurable set of panels that display detailed debug information about the current request/response, including SQL queries, templates, caching, and more. It enhances Django development by providing real-time insights and supports third-party community panels. Compatible with Django 4.2+, with experimental async view support.

repos.description: Create *beautiful* command-line interfaces with Python
repos.summary_zh: docopt 是一个 Python 命令行接口生成工具，通过编写美观的文档字符串自动生成解析器，支持基于 Usage 模式的参数和选项解析，简化 CLI 开发流程，提升代码可读性。
repos.summary_en: docopt is a Python library that automatically generates command-line interfaces from docstrings, parsing usage patterns and options to create clean, readable CLI tools without manual parser coding.

repos.description: Git your game on!
repos.summary_zh: Githug 是一个通过游戏化方式学习 Git 命令的实践工具，包含多个难度递增的关卡，每个关卡要求玩家使用特定 Git 命令达成目标。它基于 Ruby 开发，支持跨平台运行，提供提示、重置和关卡列表功能，适合 Git 初学者系统掌握版本控制技能。
repos.summary_en: Githug is a practical game designed to teach Git through interactive levels. Each level challenges users to use specific Git commands to achieve a goal. Built in Ruby, it runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows, offering hints, resets, and level progression to help beginners master version control effectively.

repos.description: Embrace the APIs of the future. Hug aims to make developing APIs as simple as possible, but no simpler.
repos.summary_zh: Hug 是一个极简且高性能的 Python API 框架，基于 Falcon 构建，大幅简化 API 开发流程。支持自动文档生成、参数类型转换、路由装饰器等功能，强调自文档化、快速开发和测试友好，适用于现代 Python 后端服务开发。
repos.summary_en: Hug is a minimalist, high-performance Python API framework built on Falcon that simplifies API development. It features automatic documentation, type conversion, decorators for routing, and emphasizes self-documenting code, fast development, and easy testing for modern Python backend services.

repos.description: Learn javascript in one picture.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目通过一张思维导图（Mind Map）直观展示 JavaScript 核心语法与概念，涵盖函数、对象、作用域、闭包等关键知识点，适合快速查阅与教学。采用可视化设计，单图呈现语言全貌，支持多语言版本，并计划扩展 Python3 和 Go 版本。
repos.summary_en: This project visualizes JavaScript syntax and concepts in a single mind map, covering functions, objects, scope, closures, and more. Designed for quick reference and teaching, it offers a comprehensive yet concise overview. Multi-language support and upcoming Python3/Go versions enhance its utility.

repos.description: curl statistics made simple
repos.summary_zh: httpstat 是一个简洁高效的命令行工具，用于可视化 curl 请求的详细统计信息，包括 DNS 解析、TCP 连接、TLS 握手、HTTP 请求和响应等关键阶段耗时。它用 Python 编写，单文件无依赖，支持丰富的环境变量配置，适用于网络调试和性能分析。
repos.summary_en: httpstat is a simple yet powerful command-line tool that visualizes detailed curl request statistics, including DNS lookup, TCP handshake, TLS negotiation, and HTTP request/response timings. Written in single-file Python with zero dependencies, it offers rich customization via environment variables for network debugging and performance analysis.

repos.description: 🎃 A fast, out-of-the-box macOS terminal built for AI coding.
repos.summary_zh: Kaku 是一款专为 AI 编程优化的终端模拟器，基于 WezTerm 深度定制。它提供开箱即用的体验，支持零配置启动、主题自适应切换、内置 zsh 插件及轻量级高性能内核，并集成 AI 助手用于命令行错误修复与智能编码辅助。
repos.summary_en: Kaku is a high-performance terminal emulator built for AI coding, forked from WezTerm with deep customizations. It offers zero-config setup, theme-aware UI, integrated shell tools, and a built-in AI assistant for command recovery and coding support.

repos.description: A git client based on the IntelliJ platform
repos.summary_zh: Rebased 是一款基于 IntelliJ 平台构建的开源 Git 客户端，旨在替代 JetBrains 官方未实现的独立 Git 工具愿景。它剥离了 IDE 中除 Git 集成外的所有插件，并优化了界面，提供轻量级、专注的版本控制体验。支持 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 多平台安装。
repos.summary_en: Rebased is an open-source Git client built on the IntelliJ platform, designed as a standalone alternative to JetBrains' discontinued Git tool initiative. It strips down the full IDE to only Git integration with UI enhancements, offering a lightweight, focused version control experience across Linux, Windows, and macOS.

repos.description: Python package for doing RPA
repos.summary_zh: RPA for Python 是一个强大的自动化工具包，提供简洁的 API 实现网页、桌面应用及 OCR 流程的自动化，支持跨平台运行，适用于重复性任务的高效处理，显著提升工作效率。
repos.summary_en: RPA for Python is a powerful automation toolkit offering a simple API to automate web, desktop, and OCR workflows across platforms, enabling efficient handling of repetitive tasks with minimal code.

repos.description: iFlow cli is a comprehensive command-line intelligence that embeds in your terminal, analyzes your repositories, does coding tasks, interprets your needs across contexts, and boosts efficiency by performing tasks from simple file operations to complex workflow automation.
repos.summary_zh: iFlow CLI 是一款终端内嵌的 AI 智能助手，支持自然语言交互、代码仓库分析、多模态输入及复杂工作流自动化。集成 iFlow 开放市场，一键安装 MCP 工具与子代理，提供免费版多模态模型（如 Kimi K2、Qwen3 Coder）支持，具备计划模式、任务压缩、插件扩展等高级功能，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: iFlow CLI is an AI-powered terminal assistant that analyzes codebases, executes coding tasks, and automates workflows via natural language. It integrates free multimodal models (e.g., Kimi K2, Qwen3 Coder), supports SubAgents and MCP tools from its Open Market, and offers advanced features like plan mode, context compression, and plugin support for enhanced developer productivity.

repos.description: Warcraft III Peon voice notifications (+ more!) for Claude Code, Codex, IDEs, and any AI agent. Stop babysitting your terminal. Employ a Peon today.
repos.summary_zh: peon-ping 是一款为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf 等）提供 Warcraft III 等游戏角色语音通知的开源工具，支持多平台（macOS/Linux/Windows/WSL2）。通过语音和屏幕横幅提醒开发者任务完成或需要交互，避免终端监控中断工作流，同时支持自定义音效包和 MCP 集成。
repos.summary_en: peon-ping is an open-source tool that delivers Warcraft III and other game character voice notifications to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It alerts users via audio and on-screen banners when tasks complete or require attention, eliminating constant terminal monitoring. Supports cross-platform use, custom sound packs, and MCP integration.

repos.description: 🚀 KIMI AI 长文本大模型逆向API【特长：长文本解读整理】，支持高速流式输出、智能体对话、联网搜索、探索版、K1思考模型、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: KIMI AI 长文本大模型逆向API，支持高速流式输出、多轮对话、联网搜索、智能体对话、长文档解读及图像解析，零配置部署，兼容ChatGPT接口，支持多路token轮询与自动会话清理，仅供测试用途。
repos.summary_en: KIMI AI long-text LLM reverse API supporting high-speed streaming, multi-turn dialogue, web search, agent conversations, document interpretation, and image parsing. Zero-config deployment, ChatGPT-compatible interface, multi-token support, and automatic session cleanup. For testing only.

repos.description: cursor IDE enjoy VIP
repos.summary_zh: cursor-vip 是一个通过共享方式解锁 Cursor IDE 付费 VIP 功能的工具，支持多语言配置与代理模式。它提供稳定的 Claude 模型访问，通过脚本或二进制文件快速部署，适用于开发者绕过区域限制使用高级 AI 编程功能，但稳定性不及官方版本。
repos.summary_en: cursor-vip is a tool that unlocks Cursor IDE's paid VIP features via shared access, supporting multi-language configuration and proxy modes. It offers stable Claude model access, easy deployment via scripts or binaries, and enables developers to use advanced AI coding features despite regional payment restrictions, though with lower stability than the official version.

repos.description: A light and plugable JavaScript library for integrated 2D/3D maps.
repos.summary_zh: maptalks-gl 是一个基于 WebGL 和 WebGPU 驱动的全新地图引擎，专为高性能 2D/3D 地图可视化而设计。支持矢量切片、3DTiles 和 GLTF 格式，提供丰富的 3D 分析功能与交通模拟动画，兼容旧版 maptalks API，便于迁移。
repos.summary_en: maptalks-gl is a WebGL and WebGPU-driven map engine for high-performance 2D/3D mapping. It supports vector tiles, 3DTiles, and GLTF formats, offering advanced 3D analysis and traffic simulation. With backward-compatible APIs, it enables seamless migration from legacy maptalks.

repos.description: Telegram Bot API server
repos.summary_zh: Telegram Bot API官方服务器实现，支持本地自托管部署。提供完整Bot API HTTP接口，支持无限制文件下载、2000MB大文件上传、自定义Webhook地址与端口。适用于高并发场景、数据隐私保护及绕过官方API限制的企业级应用。
repos.summary_en: Official Telegram Bot API server implementation supporting self-hosted deployment. Provides complete Bot API HTTP interface with unlimited file downloads, 2000MB upload support, and custom webhook configuration. Ideal for high-concurrency scenarios, data privacy protection, and enterprise applications requiring API customization.

repos.description: Chrome extension & CLI to let agents control your browser. Runs Playwright snippets in a stateful sandbox. Available as CLI or MCP
repos.summary_zh: Playwriter 是一款 Chrome 扩展工具，允许 AI 智能体通过 CLI 或 MCP 协议控制用户浏览器。它直接连接已登录的 Chrome 实例，保留用户会话状态（如 cookies、扩展），避免新建浏览器带来的安全风险和检测问题。核心功能包括 Playwright API 调用、多会话隔离、网络请求拦截、页面调试编辑等，适用于自动化测试、数据采集和智能体交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Playwriter is a Chrome extension enabling AI agents to control your browser via CLI or MCP. It connects directly to your running Chrome instance, preserving logins, extensions, and cookies—avoiding the security risks and detection issues of spawning new browsers. Key features include full Playwright API access, isolated sessions, network interception, page debugging, and live code editing for automation, testing, and agent-driven workflows.

repos.description: 签到
repos.summary_zh: qiandao 是一个基于 HAR 编辑器的自动化签到框架，支持多平台自动签到任务管理。核心功能包括通过 HAR 文件录制与编辑浏览器操作，结合 Python 脚本实现定时自动签到，支持邮件通知与数据库存储。提供 Web 管理界面与 Docker 部署方案，适用于各类周期性签到场景，如论坛、学习平台等。
repos.summary_en: Qiandao is an automated check-in framework based on HAR editor, enabling scheduled check-ins across multiple platforms. It records and edits browser actions via HAR files, executes tasks using Python scripts, and supports email notifications and database storage. Features include a web admin interface and Docker deployment, ideal for recurring check-in scenarios such as forums and learning platforms.

repos.description: 做最好的接口管理平台
repos.summary_zh: DOClever 是一款专为中小型团队打造的商业化开源接口管理平台，完全免费并支持内网部署。它提供接口全生命周期管理、可视化调试、Mock 服务、自动化测试、团队协作及多格式导入导出等功能，支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议及多种参数类型，具备版本控制与快照能力，助力高效开发协作。
repos.summary_en: DOClever is a commercial open-source API management platform, fully free and supportable for on-premise deployment. It offers comprehensive API lifecycle management, visual debugging, Mock services, automated testing, team collaboration, and import/export in multiple formats. Supporting HTTP/HTTPS protocols and various parameter types, it features version control, snapshots, and seamless integration with Postman, Swagger, and RAP.

repos.description: AutoJs6-based ant forest energy auto-collect script (基于 AutoJs6 的蚂蚁森林能量自动收取脚本)
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Auto.js 6 的蚂蚁森林能量自动收取脚本，支持自动收集好友能量、能量雨识别与点击、排行榜策略配置等功能，提供模块化扩展与配置工具，适用于 Android 设备自动化操作，显著提升蚂蚁森林能量获取效率。
repos.summary_en: An Auto.js 6-based script for automating energy collection in Ant Forest, featuring auto-collection of friend energy, rain energy detection, ranking strategies, and modular configuration tools to enhance efficiency on Android devices.

repos.description: splinter - python test framework for web applications
repos.summary_zh: Splinter 是一个简洁易用的 Python Web 应用自动化测试框架，提供直观的 API 支持浏览器交互自动化。它基于 Selenium 构建，支持多浏览器驱动，具备快速开发、灵活扩展和真实场景适配能力，适用于 Web 测试、爬虫及自动化任务。
repos.summary_en: Splinter is a simple and consistent Python framework for automating web applications. Built on Selenium, it offers an intuitive API for browser automation, supporting multiple drivers and real-world use cases. Ideal for testing, scraping, and UI automation with robust and flexible capabilities.

repos.description: 🚀 A statistical analysis tool for performance testing
repos.summary_zh: Hiper 是一款专为性能测试设计的统计分析工具，支持通过 Chrome 浏览器自动化采集页面加载时间、DNS 查询、TCP 连接等关键性能指标，提供详细的统计报告与可视化分析，适用于 Web 性能监控与优化。
repos.summary_en: Hiper is a statistical analysis tool for performance testing that automates Chrome browser interactions to collect key metrics like DNS lookup, TCP connection, and page load times, delivering detailed reports and visualizations for web performance monitoring and optimization.

repos.description: Modern photo gallery for photographers, with S3/GitHub sync, EXIF details, maps, and a WebGL viewer.
repos.summary_zh: Afilmory 是一款专为摄影师打造的高性能现代照片画廊平台，支持 S3/GitHub 同步、EXIF 元数据展示、地理地图可视化和 WebGL 渲染，提供响应式瀑布流布局和国际化支持，适用于自建或 SaaS 部署。
repos.summary_en: Afilmory is a modern, high-performance photo gallery platform for photographers, featuring S3/GitHub sync, EXIF metadata, interactive maps, and WebGL rendering. Built with React + TypeScript, it offers responsive masonry layouts, multi-storage support, and HDR/Live Photo compatibility for professional photo curation.

repos.description: Collaborator is a place to create with agents.
repos.summary_zh: Collaborator 是一个专为 AI 智能体协作设计的 macOS 桌面应用，提供无限画布环境，集成终端、代码编辑器和文件管理功能。支持多工作区、实时终端交互和拖拽式文件操作，采用 Electron + React 技术栈，所有数据本地存储，适用于端到端的智能体开发流程。
repos.summary_en: Collaborator is a macOS-native desktop app for building with AI agents, featuring an infinite canvas workspace with integrated terminals, code editors, and file navigation. It supports multi-workspace management, real-time agent interaction, and local data storage, built on Electron, React, and xterm.js for seamless agentic development.

repos.description: Magic auto brightness based on screen contents 💡
repos.summary_zh: Lumen 是一款 macOS 菜单栏应用，能根据屏幕内容自动调节亮度。用户只需使用亮度键即可控制，系统会自动学习偏好。当屏幕显示深色内容（如终端）时自动调亮，显示浅色内容（如网页）时自动调暗，显著提升夜间使用舒适度，尤其适合长时间编程或阅读。
repos.summary_en: Lumen is a macOS menu bar app that automatically adjusts screen brightness based on displayed content. It learns user preferences via brightness keys, brightening the screen for dark content (e.g., terminal) and dimming it for light content (e.g., web pages), offering a more comfortable viewing experience, especially at night.

repos.description: worktree coding agents command center.
repos.summary_zh: Supacode 是一个原生终端编码智能体指挥中心，专为 macOS 设计。它采用 Swift Composable Architecture 构建，集成 libghostty 实现高性能终端交互，支持通过 mise 管理依赖，提供完整的开发、测试与格式化工具链，致力于提升终端环境下的 AI 辅助编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Supacode is a native terminal coding agent command center for macOS, built with Swift Composable Architecture and integrated with libghostty for high-performance terminal interaction. It supports dependency management via mise and offers a full development workflow including build, test, and formatting tools, focusing on enhancing AI-assisted programming in the terminal environment.

repos.description: A React markdown editor and previewer.
repos.summary_zh: MarkPlus 是一个功能强大的 React Markdown 编辑器与预览组件，支持实时编辑、多主题切换、可定制工具栏及数学公式、流程图等高级功能。它提供编辑器、预览或双栏模式，适用于内容创作与文档开发场景。
repos.summary_en: MarkPlus is a powerful React-based Markdown editor and previewer with real-time editing, customizable toolbar, multi-theme support, and advanced features like math formulas and flowcharts. It supports editor, preview, or dual-pane modes, ideal for content creation and documentation.

repos.description: 🐒一些修改自网络的油猴脚本 Some Tampermonkey scripts modified from the internet
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供一系列基于油猴脚本（Tampermonkey）的自动化工具，多数脚本改编自网络资源，涵盖网页功能增强、界面优化及实用小工具。所有脚本均托管于GreasyFork平台，支持多语言版本，具备高安装量和良好用户评价，适用于提升日常浏览与操作效率。
repos.summary_en: This repository hosts a collection of Tampermonkey user scripts, mostly modified from online sources, designed to enhance web functionality, optimize interfaces, and provide utility tools. Hosted on GreasyFork with multi-language support, these scripts boast high installation counts and positive user ratings, ideal for improving browsing efficiency and user experience.

repos.description: 😁 git commit message emoji 使用指南
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供了一套中文化的 Git Commit Emoji 使用指南，涵盖 30+ 个常用 emoji 及其对应代码，用于规范提交信息格式，提升代码历史可读性与团队协作效率。支持命令行显示 emoji，适用于多平台开发场景。
repos.summary_en: This repo provides a comprehensive guide for using Git commit emojis in Chinese, including 30+ emoji codes and their meanings to standardize commit messages, enhance code history clarity, and improve team collaboration. It supports emoji display in terminals and is suitable for cross-platform development.

repos.description: Multi-service toolkit for Tavily and Firecrawl signup automation, key validation, and isolated proxy pools.
repos.summary_zh: 该工具专注于自动化注册和验证 Tavily、Firecrawl 及 Exa 的 API Key，支持多服务并发注册、邮箱验证码自动处理、真实接口可用性验证，并可选上传至统一代理池，为 MySearch-Proxy 提供稳定上游密钥源。
repos.summary_en: This toolkit automates registration and validation of API keys for Tavily, Firecrawl, and Exa. It supports concurrent signups, email verification handling, real-time API testing, and optional upload to a unified proxy pool, serving as a reliable upstream key provider for MySearch-Proxy.

repos.description: Visual design tool for building Terminal User Interfaces
repos.summary_zh: TUIStudio 是一款类 Figma 的终端用户界面可视化设计工具，支持拖拽式组件编排、实时 ANSI 预览、多框架代码导出（Ink/BubbleTea/Textual 等），内置 20+ TUI 组件与丰富主题系统，提供绝对/弹性/网格布局引擎及完整撤销重做功能。
repos.summary_en: TUIStudio is a Figma-like visual editor for designing Terminal UIs, featuring drag-and-drop components, live ANSI preview, multi-framework export (Ink/BubbleTea/Textual), 20+ built-in TUI elements, layout engines (absolute/flex/grid), and real-time theme switching with gradient support.

repos.description: Hacknical, hacker & technical. A website for GitHub user to make a better resume.
repos.summary_zh: Hacknical 是一个专为 GitHub 用户打造的在线简历生成平台，通过深度分析用户的 GitHub 贡献、代码仓库、技术栈等数据，自动生成可视化分析报告，帮助用户打造专业、数据驱动的编程简历。支持中英文切换、组织账号分析、移动端展示及 PDF 导出，技术栈涵盖 React、Koa2、MongoDB 等。
repos.summary_en: Hacknical is a web platform designed for GitHub users to generate data-driven resumes by analyzing their GitHub contributions, repositories, and tech stacks. It provides visual analytics and exportable reports, supporting English, organizations, mobile viewing, and PDF export with a tech stack including React, Koa2, and MongoDB.

repos.description: :books: 一起写Python文章，一起看Python文章 - 利用readthedocs的Python技术文章的收集和翻译。
repos.summary_zh: PyZh 是一个基于 ReadTheDocs 的 Python 技术文章翻译与收集项目，致力于汇聚优质英文技术文档并提供中文翻译。项目采用 RST 格式编写，支持多语言协作，提供 RSS 订阅和在线浏览功能，鼓励社区共同参与内容创作与翻译。
repos.summary_en: PyZh is a Python technology article translation and collection project built on ReadTheDocs, aiming to aggregate high-quality English technical articles with Chinese translations. It uses RST format, supports collaborative writing, offers RSS subscription and online reading, and encourages community contributions.

repos.description: A feature-rich, efficient text editor - Web Site
repos.summary_zh: Yu Writer Site 是一个功能丰富、高效的文本编辑器网站，提供现代化的写作体验。支持 Markdown 编辑、实时预览、多主题切换和本地存储，适用于内容创作者和开发者。项目采用轻量级架构，注重性能与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: Yu Writer Site is a feature-rich, efficient text editor web application offering a modern writing experience. It supports Markdown editing, live preview, multi-theme switching, and local storage, ideal for content creators and developers. Built with a lightweight architecture focused on performance and user experience.

repos.summary_zh: 这是一个简洁的 GitHub 仓库，项目名称为 'bye'，带有告别表情符号，可能用于快速退出或关闭某个进程、服务或应用，适合作为轻量级工具或脚本使用。
repos.summary_en: This is a simple GitHub repository named 'bye' with a farewell emoji, likely intended as a lightweight utility or script for exiting or closing processes, services, or applications.

repos.description: A CLI for BOSS 直聘 — search jobs, view recommendations, manage applications via reverse-engineered API
repos.summary_zh: boss-cli 是一个基于逆向工程 API 的 BOSS 直聘命令行工具，支持职位搜索、个性化推荐、申请管理、与招聘者聊天及发送问候等功能。具备多浏览器 Cookie 自动提取、丰富筛选条件、结构化输出和跨平台支持，适用于求职自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: boss-cli is a CLI tool for BOSS Zhipin that enables job searching, recommendations, application management, and recruiter chat via reverse-engineered APIs. It supports browser cookie extraction, advanced filtering, structured output, and cross-platform usage for automated job hunting.

repos.description: ridiculously fast object serialization
repos.summary_zh: serpy 是一个极致快速的 Python 对象序列化框架，专为高性能场景设计。它支持将复杂数据类型（如 Django 模型、自定义类）高效转换为原生类型（字典、列表等），并易于转为 JSON。相比 marshmallow 或 Django REST Framework，其性能优势可达一个数量级以上，同时保持简洁的类继承式架构和高度可定制性。
repos.summary_en: serpy is a ridiculously fast object serialization framework for Python, optimized for high performance. It efficiently converts complex data types (e.g., Django models, custom classes) into native Python types (dicts, lists), easily convertible to JSON. It outperforms alternatives like marshmallow or Django REST Framework by an order of magnitude, while offering a clean, extensible class-based design with minimal code duplication.

repos.description: 清理Augment缓存和生成设备SessionId/解决 VSCode、Cursor、JetBrains 系列 IDE 中 Augment 插件无法登录的问题（Sign in failed. If you have a firewall, please add）/将所有 d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com 域名统一指向延迟最低的服务器IP
repos.summary_zh: Augment 插件清理工具 v3.4 是一款专为解决 VSCode、Cursor、JetBrains 系列 IDE 中 Augment 插件登录失败问题而设计的跨平台工具。核心功能包括彻底清理插件缓存数据、生成设备 SessionId，以及通过智能测速优化 API 域名解析（将 d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com 指向延迟最低服务器）。支持交互式菜单和命令行模式，提供代理配置、安全预览等高级功能，兼容 Windows/macOS/Linux。
repos.summary_en: Augment Plugin Cleaner v3.4 is a cross-platform utility designed to resolve login failures in Augment plugin for VSCode, Cursor, and JetBrains IDEs. It features comprehensive cache/data cleanup, SessionId generation, and intelligent API domain optimization by testing latency of d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com endpoints. Supports interactive menus, CLI arguments, proxy configurations (Clash/V2Ray/custom), dry-run previews, and works on Windows/macOS/Linux with admin privileges for hosts file modification.

repos.description: A JavaScript library to display Photo Sphere panoramas.
repos.summary_zh: Photo Sphere Viewer 是一个基于 Three.js 的 JavaScript 库，用于在网页上展示 360×180 度全景图。支持 equirectangular 投影格式，兼容 Android 4.2+ 拍摄的照片球，提供丰富的交互控制与自定义选项，适用于虚拟旅游、房地产展示等场景。
repos.summary_en: Photo Sphere Viewer is a JavaScript library built on Three.js for displaying 360×180 degree panoramas on web pages. It supports equirectangular projection, integrates with Android Photo Sphere, and offers extensive customization and interaction features for immersive experiences.

repos.description: A minimal modern terminal for AI coding experience — Sidebar workspaces; horizontal / vertical split panes; one-click agent launch; per-agent activity readout; live workspace state with one-click Node and branch switching.
repos.summary_zh: kooky 是一款专为 AI 编码打造的现代化 macOS 终端模拟器，基于 libghostty 实现 GPU 渲染。核心特性包括侧边栏工作区、多窗格分屏、一键启动 Claude Code/Gemini CLI 等多种 AI Agent、Git Worktree 隔离开发、右键选中内容直接询问 Agent、模糊快速打开面板以及多行提示词编辑器。支持会话自动恢复、跨窗口拖拽标签页，无账号无遥测，状态完全本地存储。
repos.summary_en: kooky is a minimal modern terminal emulator built for AI coding on macOS, powered by libghostty with GPU rendering. Key features include sidebar workspaces, horizontal/vertical split panes, one-click launch of Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, and other AI agents, Git Worktree isolation, right-click-to-ask-agent on selections, fuzzy Quick Open panel, and a multi-line prompt composer. Sessions auto-resume across restarts, tabs are draggable across panes and windows, and all state stays local with no accounts or telemetry.

repos.description: Document Web APIs made with Django Rest Framework
repos.summary_zh: DRF Docs 是一个专为 Django Rest Framework 设计的 API 文档自动生成工具，支持 Python 2.7/3.x 和 Django 1.8+。它能自动解析 DRF 项目中的 API 结构，生成交互式文档页面，并提供配置选项控制文档可见性。项目包含演示环境，支持模板扩展，适用于需要快速搭建标准化 API 文档的中大型后端服务。
repos.summary_en: DRF Docs is an automated API documentation generator for Django Rest Framework, supporting Python 2.7/3.x and Django 1.8+. It auto-generates interactive API docs by parsing DRF project structures, with configurable visibility and template extension support. Includes a demo project for development and testing, ideal for medium-to-large backend services requiring standardized API documentation.

repos.description: Community fetch recipes for bb-browser — pre-built adapters for Reddit, Twitter, GitHub, and more
repos.summary_zh: bb-sites 是 bb-browser 的社区站点适配器集合，提供 95+ 个预置脚本，将主流平台（如 Reddit、Twitter、GitHub、YouTube、Bilibili 等）转换为 CLI 命令。无需 API 密钥或反爬绕过，直接通过浏览器环境运行，支持搜索、内容抓取、用户交互等场景，实现网页内容的命令行化访问。
repos.summary_en: bb-sites is a community-driven collection of site adapters for bb-browser, enabling websites like Reddit, Twitter, GitHub, and YouTube to be accessed via CLI commands. With 95+ pre-built adapters across 35 platforms, it allows direct content retrieval without API keys or anti-bot workarounds, leveraging the browser's logged-in state for seamless automation.

repos.description: A review extension for Pi
repos.summary_zh: pi-review 是 Pi AI 编码助手的代码审查扩展，支持通过简洁指令审查未提交变更、分支、提交、PR 及指定文件快照，输出优先级分明的审查结论与可操作建议，并支持自定义审查规范。
repos.summary_en: pi-review is a code review extension for Pi AI coding assistant. It supports reviewing uncommitted changes, branches, commits, PRs, and file snapshots via simple commands, producing prioritized findings with actionable suggestions and custom review guidelines.

repos.description: Python项目自动化多服务器部署的工具
repos.summary_zh: essay 是一个基于 Fabric 的 Python 项目自动化部署工具，支持多服务器打包与部署。它通过标准化流程简化开发到生产环境的交付，集成 PyPI 服务器和 Git 仓库，提供快速构建、版本化打包、虚拟环境管理及 Supervisord 进程控制，适用于需高效扩展的 Python 服务场景。
repos.summary_en: Essay is a Python project automation deployment tool based on Fabric, supporting multi-server packaging and deployment. It streamlines the development-to-production pipeline with standardized workflows, integrating PyPI servers and Git repositories. It enables rapid builds, versioned packaging, virtual environment management, and Supervisord process control, ideal for scalable Python service deployments.

repos.description: :zap: Sync all of your VSCode settings across multiple devices, supports any VSCode variant.
repos.summary_zh: VSCode Syncing 是一款强大的 VSCode 扩展，支持跨设备同步用户设置、键位绑定、扩展、语言包和代码片段至 GitHub Gist。支持增量同步、自动安装扩展、代理配置，并兼容 VSCodium、Cursor 等 VSCode 衍生版本。
repos.summary_en: VSCode Syncing is a powerful extension that synchronizes all VSCode settings—including user settings, keybindings, extensions, snippets, and locales—across multiple devices via GitHub Gist. It supports incremental sync, automatic extension management, proxy configuration, and works with any VSCode variant like VSCodium and Cursor.

repos.summary_zh: LazyTyper 是一个自动化输入工具，通过预定义脚本实现快速文本输入与操作，适用于重复性任务场景。本仓库提供其各版本的二进制发布文件，方便用户直接下载使用。
repos.summary_en: LazyTyper is an automation tool that enables rapid text input and operations via predefined scripts, ideal for repetitive tasks. This repository hosts binary releases for easy download and deployment.

repos.description: Agent-Native Terminal
repos.summary_zh: Termany 是一款 Agent-Native 终端，采用本地优先、云端就绪的架构。通过统一的 React 与 xterm.js 界面，支持 Web、桌面（Tauri）及未来云端部署。核心亮点在于无缝集成 Claude、Codex 等十余种主流 AI 编码代理，支持分屏多任务、文件树内嵌编辑与预览，并提供详细的 AI 使用成本与 Token 消耗分析面板。
repos.summary_en: Termany is an agent-native terminal with a local-first, cloud-ready architecture. It unifies Web, desktop (Tauri), and future cloud deployments under a single React and xterm.js UI. Key features include seamless integration of over a dozen AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, etc.), split-pane multitasking, inline file editing/preview, and a detailed dashboard for tracking AI usage costs and token consumption.

repos.summary_zh: Auto.js 是一个基于无障碍服务的 Android 平台 JavaScript IDE，支持自动化操作、界面录制、控件选择器及脚本打包。本修改版修复了内存泄漏、优化调度机制、集成 PaddleOCR、ONNXRuntime 和 ncnn 推理引擎，增强模型本地推理能力，适用于蚂蚁森林等脚本场景，同时支持防检测变包名功能。
repos.summary_en: Auto.js is an Android-based JavaScript IDE leveraging accessibility services for automation, featuring UI recording, powerful selector APIs, and APK packaging. This modified version fixes memory leaks, integrates PaddleOCR, ONNXRuntime, and ncnn for local model inference, supports anti-detection via fake package names, and is optimized for stable script execution in apps like Ant Forest.

repos.description: A native macOS workspace terminal organized around Projects and Worktrees, powered by tmux and libghostty
repos.summary_zh: Mori 是一款专为 macOS 设计的原生终端工作空间管理工具，围绕 Git 项目的 Worktree 构建，通过 tmux 实现持久化会话管理，并集成 libghostty 提供 GPU 加速的终端渲染。支持本地与远程仓库、项目级导航、独立分支会话及 SwiftUI 侧边栏交互，提供类 IDE 的高效开发体验。
repos.summary_en: Mori is a native macOS terminal workspace manager centered on Projects and Git Worktrees, powered by tmux for persistent sessions and libghostty for GPU-accelerated terminal rendering. It enables project-first navigation, local/remote repo support, independent branch sessions, and a SwiftUI sidebar interface, delivering an IDE-like development workflow.

repos.description: 微信客户端模拟器，方便在本地进行微信公众平台API的开发和调试
repos.summary_zh: 微信客户端模拟器，基于tkinter开发，提供本地微信公众平台API调试环境。支持模拟关注/取消关注、自定义菜单点击等交互场景，通过XML数据模拟微信消息推送，简化开发测试流程。
repos.summary_en: WeChat client simulator built with tkinter for local debugging of WeChat Official Platform APIs. It simulates user interactions like following/unfollowing accounts and clicking custom menu items via XML data, enabling streamlined development and testing workflows.

repos.description: An efficient API documentation management tool that fully adheres to the OpenAPI specification and incorporates advanced LLM technology. This tool can automate the generation of API documentation, data models, and test cases, greatly enhancing development efficiency and documentation quality.
repos.summary_zh: ApiCat 是一款高效 API 文档管理工具，完全遵循 OpenAPI 规范，集成先进 LLM 技术，可自动化生成 API 文档、数据模型和测试用例，显著提升开发效率与文档质量，支持本地部署与云端服务。
repos.summary_en: ApiCat is an efficient API documentation management tool fully compliant with the OpenAPI specification. It leverages advanced LLM technology to automate API documentation, data model, and test case generation, significantly enhancing development efficiency and documentation quality. Supports local deployment and cloud services.

repos.description: Assistant for get HTTP ONLY Cookies.
repos.summary_zh: GetCookies 是一款 Chrome 扩展插件，专为突破 HTTP ONLY 限制而设计，可安全获取指定域下的 Cookie 数据。通过自定义 DOM 属性触发 Cookie 提取，支持跨域、指定名称与域名，并通过 postMessage 机制实现安全的跨页面通信，适用于自动化登录与数据抓取场景。
repos.summary_en: GetCookies is a Chrome extension that bypasses HTTP ONLY restrictions to securely extract cookies from specified domains. It triggers cookie retrieval via custom DOM attributes, supports cross-domain access, allows naming and domain filtering, and uses postMessage for safe cross-page communication, ideal for automation and login workflows.

repos.summary_zh: Atlas 是专为 OpenClaw 生态设计的专业 AI 赏金猎人技能，支持自动发现 GitHub、Upwork 等平台的高回报任务，通过智能 ROI 矩阵评估收益与成本，并生成高质量代码提交。具备身份管理、止损保护及自动化交付能力，助力智能体高效完成付费任务。
repos.summary_en: Atlas is a professional AI bounty hunter skill for the OpenClaw ecosystem, autonomously discovering high-value tasks on GitHub, Upwork, and bug bounty platforms. It uses a smart ROI matrix to evaluate profitability, manages identity as a senior developer, and delivers high-quality pull requests with test evidence, featuring built-in stop-loss protection.

repos.description: Deepin Terminal written by vala
repos.summary_zh: Deepin Terminal 是深度操作系统默认终端模拟器，基于 Vala 语言开发，支持多标签页、分屏、快捷键操作及主题定制，提供高效命令行工作环境。
repos.summary_en: Deepin Terminal is the default terminal emulator for Deepin OS, built with Vala, offering multi-tab, split-screen, customizable shortcuts, and theming for efficient command-line workflows.

repos.description: top, but for the HTTP endpoints on your host — a live dashboard of the most active plaintext HTTP endpoints, right in the terminal.
repos.summary_zh: httpinspect 是一款基于 eBPF 的终端实时监控工具，类比 top 命令，直接在内核 TC 层抓取网卡明文 HTTP 请求，按流量、速率和延迟排序展示活跃端点。无需代理、Sidecar 或修改应用代码，支持回环接口监控本地微服务通信，提供 p50/p95/max 延迟、状态码分布及每秒请求数等详细指标。
repos.summary_en: httpinspect is an eBPF-powered terminal live dashboard that ranks plaintext HTTP endpoints by traffic, rate, and latency — like top, but for HTTP. It attaches at the TC layer to read packets directly off the wire with no proxy, sidecar, or application changes. It covers loopback traffic for local microservice chatter and surfaces per-endpoint latency percentiles, status-code mix, and req/s sparklines in a TUI.

repos.description: Twitter Trend Radar
repos.summary_zh: Twitter Trend Radar 是一款实时扫描 Twitter/X 上带有链接且具备传播力推文的反向域名侦察工具。它通过提取
repos.summary_en: Twitter Trend Radar scans X/Twitter in real time for tweets carrying links and traction, then reverse-looks up each domain's registration age and recent traffic to surface emerging products before Google Trends catches up. It uses launch-signal phrase pools, greylisting of major sites, WHOIS age checks, and 3-month traffic bar charts. A zero-dependency local proxy keeps API keys on-device with no build step required.

repos.description: :metro: 即刻 Ⓙ SDK
repos.summary_zh: Jike Metro 🚇 是一个即刻（Jike）平台的 Python SDK，提供用户信息获取、动态浏览、内容发布、收藏管理、评论互动等全套接口，支持流式数据拉取与自动化操作，适用于开发者快速集成即刻生态功能。
repos.summary_en: Jike Metro 🚇 is a Python SDK for the Jike platform, offering comprehensive APIs for user profiles, news feeds, content creation, collections, comments, and interactions. It supports streaming data and automation, enabling developers to integrate Jike's ecosystem efficiently.

repos.description: Git worktree-based task manager with integrated terminals for CLI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: Ouijit 是一款基于 Git worktree 的 AI 编程代理任务管理器，集成终端会话、生命周期钩子与脚本系统，支持 Claude Code、Codex 等代理工具。提供看板式任务管理、自动并行工作流、实时代理状态通知、VM 沙箱隔离及会话恢复等功能，无需账号、无遥测，专为 AI 辅助开发流程打造。
repos.summary_en: Ouijit is a Git worktree-based task and terminal session manager designed for AI coding agents. It integrates with Claude Code, Codex, and other agent CLIs via lifecycle hooks, scripts, and a session-aware CLI. Features include kanban task management, automatic parallel workstreams, live agent status with notifications, VM sandboxing for untrusted code, and session resumption—fully open-source with no accounts or telemetry.

repos.summary_zh: Content Signal Radar 是一个基于 GitHub Actions 的自动化信号情报系统，从 X、博客、播客、即刻、公众号等多源抓取信息，通过去重、评分和噪声过滤，生成结构化信号报告。它不是新闻摘要，而是面向内容创作者和产品决策者的决策辅助系统，输出可直接用于 X 推文草稿、小红书选题或产品洞察，支持 Telegram 推送和仪表盘集成。
repos.summary_en: Content Signal Radar is an automated signal intelligence system powered by GitHub Actions. It ingests feeds from X, blogs, podcasts, Jike, and WeChat public accounts, then deduplicates, scores, and filters noise to produce structured signal reports. Designed for content creators and product decision-makers, it generates actionable outputs—X drafts, Xiaohongshu angles, and product signals—deliverable via stdout, Telegram, or dashboard integration.

repos.description: PyTime is an easy-use Python module which aims to operate date/time/datetime by string.
repos.summary_zh: PyTime 是一个简洁易用的 Python 模块，专注于通过字符串操作日期、时间和 datetime 对象。它支持解析非标准格式的日期字符串（如 '2015.5.17'、'April 3rd 2015'），并允许通过自然语言式字符串进行时间加减运算（如 '2years 3mon'）。同时提供周、月时间区间计算及节日生成功能，适用于脚本自动化与数据处理场景。
repos.summary_en: PyTime is a user-friendly Python module designed to handle date/time/datetime operations via string input. It parses irregular date formats (e.g., '2015.5.17', 'NOV21th2015') and supports natural-language-like timedelta calculations (e.g., '2years 3mon'). Features include week/month interval generation, holiday computation, and datetime arithmetic, making it ideal for automation and data processing tasks.

repos.description: Bird is a cli for twitter, so your agents can tweet.
repos.summary_zh: Bird 是一款基于命令行界面的 X (Twitter) 客户端，专为自动化脚本和 AI 智能体设计。它支持通过浏览器 Cookie 或 Sweetistics API 进行身份验证，提供发推、回复、读取推文、搜索及查看提及等核心功能，并支持 JSON 格式输出，便于集成到自动化工作流中。
repos.summary_en: Bird is a fast command-line interface for X (Twitter), designed for automation scripts and AI agents. It supports authentication via browser cookies or the Sweetistics API, offering core functionalities like tweeting, replying, reading, searching, and viewing mentions. It also supports JSON output for seamless integration into automated workflows.

repos.summary_zh: 10xagent 是一个极简的 AI Agent 原型，仅用 10 行 JavaScript 代码实现了基于 for 循环、工具调用与 LLM 的自进化 Harness。通过 30-50 轮迭代，Agent 能自主优化代码、执行 Bash 命令并验证结果，展示了 AI 自我进化的核心原理。
repos.summary_en: 10xagent is a minimal AI Agent prototype that implements a self-evolving harness using just 10 lines of JavaScript code with for-loop, tool calling, and LLM. Through 30-50 iterations, the agent autonomously optimizes code, executes Bash commands, and verifies results, demonstrating the core principles of AI self-evolution.

repos.description: Detect file modification in background and push it to git automatically.
repos.summary_zh: file_sync 是一个轻量级自动化工具，通过监听文件变化并自动提交到 Git 仓库，实现配置文件的实时同步与版本追踪。支持跨平台运行，可设置开机自启，适用于个人配置文件管理场景。
repos.summary_en: file_sync is a lightweight automation tool that monitors file modifications in the background and automatically pushes changes to a Git repository, enabling real-time synchronization and version tracking of configuration files. It supports cross-platform operation and can be configured to run at system startup.

repos.description: A minimalist, terminal-style new tab page for your browser.
repos.summary_zh: Neko-Tab 是一款极简终端风格的浏览器新标签页扩展，基于 React + TypeScript + Vite 构建。核心亮点是键盘优先的命令面板（Ctrl+K），集成模糊搜索、URL 别名、内置计算器、标签页搜索、多搜索引擎切换及 AI 命令解释器（支持 OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini）。AI 模块可学习浏览历史、智能解析自然语言指令（如打开多个应用），并支持基于历史记录的问答与日志保存。提供 22+ 主题、自定义 ASCII 艺术和便签本功能。
repos.summary_en: Neko-Tab is a minimalist, terminal-style browser new tab extension built with React, TypeScript, and Vite. Its keyboard-first command palette (Ctrl+K) unifies fuzzy search, URL aliases, a built-in calculator, tab switching, multi-engine search, and an AI command interpreter (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini). The AI learns from browsing history, resolves natural-language navigation, answers history-based Q&A, and saves summaries to a journal. Features 22+ themes, custom ASCII art, and a scratchpad.

repos.description: python code style guide book / python 代码、单元测试和项目规范
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是 Python 代码风格、单元测试与项目规范的完整指南，旨在为 Python 项目（尤其是 Web 项目）提供统一的开发标准。涵盖代码风格、测试实践、项目结构等核心内容，支持在线阅读与多种格式下载，采用 CC0 许可，鼓励社区协作完善。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a comprehensive Python code style guide, unit testing practices, and project standards, particularly for web projects. It covers coding conventions, testing methodologies, and project structure, available for online reading and download in multiple formats. Released under CC0, it encourages community contributions to improve and expand the guide.

repos.description: 用 LLM 和 jina reader 生成的总结
repos.summary_zh: 该项目利用 LLM 和 jina reader 自动读取 bookmark-collection 中的网页书签内容，生成结构化摘要。通过 GitHub Action 实现自动化处理，支持按月归档，适用于个人知识管理和内容聚合，核心亮点在于结合 AI 总结与网页内容提取技术。
repos.summary_en: This project uses LLM and jina reader to automatically extract and summarize web content from bookmarks in bookmark-collection. Integrated with GitHub Actions for automation, it supports monthly archiving and enables personal knowledge management through AI-powered content aggregation and summarization.

repos.description: singleFile + gh pages + deepseek api + notion db + tg bot = web clipper and notify
repos.summary_zh: Web Clipper Backend 是一个网页剪藏服务，支持将网页通过 SingleFile 插件保存至 GitHub Pages，利用 DeepSeek API 自动生成摘要与标签，并同步至 Notion 数据库，同时通过 Telegram Bot 推送通知，实现全自动化内容归档与知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Web Clipper Backend is an automated web clipping service that saves web pages via SingleFile to GitHub Pages, uses DeepSeek API for AI-generated summaries and tags, syncs data to Notion database, and sends notifications via Telegram Bot, enabling seamless content archiving and knowledge management.

repos.description: Cached instances for Django REST Framework
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为 Django REST Framework (DRF) 提供缓存实例功能，通过将序列化后的实例数据存储在缓存中，显著提升 API 读取性能。支持零数据库查询读取实例或仅一次查询获取主键列表，适用于高读负载场景。核心机制包括缓存代理类、JSON 序列化及缓存失效策略。
repos.summary_en: This project enhances Django REST Framework (DRF) by caching serialized instance data, enabling zero or minimal database queries for read-heavy APIs. It uses a cache-aware proxy to store only necessary attributes, including foreign keys and relations, improving performance for APIs with complex object relationships.

repos.description: python_sdk for TencentYoutuyun-person-face-service
repos.summary_zh: 腾讯云优图人脸服务Python SDK，提供人脸检测、比对、识别、验证及人脸库管理功能，支持本地图片与URL输入，集成API签名鉴权，适用于身份认证、安防监控等场景。
repos.summary_en: Tencent YouTu Face Service Python SDK enables face detection, comparison, recognition, and verification, with support for local images and URLs. It includes API authentication and person/group management, ideal for identity verification and security applications.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastMCP 框架的 VSCode 扩展，将 VSCode 转换为 MCP 服务器，支持通过 HTTP Streaming 和 SSE 协议远程执行内部命令，提供工作区信息查询、异步执行、命令白名单等能力，兼容 Model Context Protocol 标准。
repos.summary_en: A VSCode extension using FastMCP framework to convert VSCode into an MCP server, enabling remote execution of internal commands via HTTP Streaming and SSE, with workspace info, async execution, command whitelisting, and full Model Context Protocol compatibility.

repos.description: A controllable timing task widgets with Celery
repos.summary_zh: celery-task-tigger 是一个基于 Celery 的可控定时任务组件，支持任务执行次数限制（max_times）和自定义执行间隔（countdown），解决了原生周期性任务依赖 beat 的痛点，实现更灵活的任务调度与控制。
repos.summary_en: celery-task-tigger is a Celery-based controllable timing task widget that supports execution frequency control (max_times) and custom intervals (countdown), solving the limitation of native periodic tasks relying on beat for more flexible task scheduling.

repos.description: An out-of-the-box, lightweight JavaScript i18n auto-translation solution
repos.summary_zh: i18n-pro/core 是一个开箱即用的轻量级 JavaScript 国际化自动翻译解决方案，支持文本提取、多平台自动翻译（如 Google、OpenAI、百度等）、增量更新和日志追踪，提供文本即键、变量插值、类型标签等功能，简化多语言开发流程。
repos.summary_en: i18n-pro/core is an out-of-the-box, lightweight JavaScript i18n auto-translation solution that supports text extraction, multi-platform translation (e.g., Google, OpenAI, Baidu), incremental updates, and logging. It offers features like text-as-key, variable interpolation, and type tags to streamline internationalization.

repos.description: 🚀 8000+ Verified n8n Workflows. Free to download. Includes a self-hostable frontend to browse and search automation templates.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是经过验证的8000+个n8n自动化工作流的开源集合，提供可直接下载使用的JSON格式模板。包含基于Next.js 14构建的自主托管前端，支持按角色和集成智能搜索，涵盖营销、DevOps、销售和AI等场景。数据以JSON和SQL形式开放，支持本地部署，致力于让自动化技术普惠大众。
repos.summary_en: This project offers 8,000+ verified n8n automation workflows in JSON format, freely downloadable for immediate use. It includes a self-hostable Next.js 14 frontend with intelligent search by role/integration, covering marketing, DevOps, sales, and AI scenarios. Open-source data (JSON/SQL) enables local deployment, promoting accessible automation technology for all.

repos.description: 微信支付的python接口
repos.summary_zh: weixin_pay 是一个为 Python 开发者提供的微信支付接口库，简化了微信支付 API 的调用流程。该库经过实际项目测试验证，支持核心支付功能，适合快速集成到电商、服务类应用中，提升支付模块开发效率。
repos.summary_en: weixin_pay is a Python library providing a simplified interface for WeChat Pay API. Developed for production use, it supports core payment functionalities and has been tested successfully. Ideal for integrating WeChat Pay into e-commerce or service applications efficiently.

repos.description: Yet Another Pair Programming Package for Atom.
repos.summary_zh: Coeditor 是一个为 Atom 编辑器设计的实时协同编程插件，支持多用户无冲突文本编辑、语法高亮同步、文件操作同步及项目级协作感知。通过自建 WebSocket 服务器实现客户端间状态同步，适用于远程结对编程场景，需统一配置换行符以避免内容不一致。
repos.summary_en: Coeditor is a real-time collaborative programming plugin for Atom, enabling conflict-free text editing, syntax highlighting sync, file operations, and project awareness across multiple users. It relies on a custom WebSocket server for state synchronization, ideal for remote pair programming, with strict line ending consistency requirements across clients.

repos.description: Turn an approved product design, PRD, prototype, design system, or architecture brief into an AI-governed, deployable full-stack project with a pnpm monorepo, requirement traceability, canonical multi-agent rules, mandatory AI review, executable quality gates, CI, container deployment assets, and handoff evidence.
repos.summary_zh: 面向VibeCoding的Codex工程Skill，将产品设计与架构规范转化为可部署的全栈项目。采用pnpm monorepo架构，支持多Agent协同规则、AI审查、质量门禁与CI/CD流水线，Routine模式高效处理日常修复，Init模式负责标准化初始化。
repos.summary_en: A Codex engineering skill for VibeCoding that transforms product designs into deployable full-stack projects using pnpm monorepo. Supports multi-agent rules, AI review, quality gates, and CI/CD pipelines, with Routine mode for efficient daily fixes and Init mode for standardized project setup.

repos.description: Natural language to shell command. Type what you want, get the exact command + explanation. Rust, 5.4MB, dual-request parallel.
repos.summary_zh: how2cli 是一款将自然语言实时转换为精确 Shell 命令的工具，支持 SSE 流式响应、会话记忆、Markdown 渲染及双模式（快速/推理）。基于 Rust 开发，单二进制部署，兼容任意 OpenAI API 端点，适用于 Linux 环境的高效命令行自动化。
repos.summary_en: how2cli is a natural language to shell command converter that instantly translates user queries into exact commands with explanations. Features SSE streaming, session memory, talk mode, dual models (fast/reasoning), and single-binary deployment in Rust. Compatible with any OAI-compatible API endpoint.
